limitations: The source manifest has no photoshoot or property boundary.
All advertised-sample groups and every group in medium-exclusive-100-v1 are excluded.
Eligible group IDs are ordered by SHA-256 of medium-dev-v1:<group_id> and greedily assigned to the currently smallest fold until each fold contains 100 images.
Reference-group-disjoint fallback folds do not prove photoshoot- or property-level leakage safety.
